mapper.select: select inbound.inbound_id as inboundId, inbound.prod_id as prodId, inbound.client_id as clientId, inbound.quantity as quantity, inbound.inbound_status as inboundStatus, inbound.req_inbound_date as reqInboundDate, inbound.ware_id as wareId, inbound.warehouse_pos_x as warehousePosX, inbound.warehouse_pos_y as warehousePosY, inbound.inbound_process_date as inboundProcessDate, product.prod_name as prodName, product.prod_price as prodPrice from inbound JOIN product ON inbound.prod_id = product.prod_id

select inbound.inbound_id as inboundId, inbound.prod_id as prodId, inbound.client_id as clientId, inbound.quantity as quantity, inbound.inbound_status as inboundStatus, inbound.req_inbound_date as reqInboundDate, inbound.ware_id as wareId, inbound.warehouse_pos_x as warehousePosX, inbound.warehouse_pos_y as warehousePosY, inbound.inbound_process_date as inboundProcessDate, product.prod_name as prodName, product.prod_price as prodPrice from inbound JOIN product ON inbound.prod_id = product.prod_id where inbound.inbound_status = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE inbound SET inbound_status = 1 WHERE prod_id = #{prodId} AND client_id = #{clientId} AND inbound_status = 0
mapper.select: SELECT quantity FROM inbound WHERE prod_id = #{prodId} AND client_id = #{clientId} AND inbound_status = 0 LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO inventory (inventory_id, prod_id, client_id, quantity, ware_id, last_inbound_date) SELECT #{inventoryId}, -- Java에서 생성한 UUID나 시퀀스 i.prod_id, i.client_id, i.quantity, i.ware_id, NOW() FROM inbound i WHERE i.prod_id = #{prodId} AND i.client_id = #{clientId}
